jar_facts.h2_auto_server: The card repository opens jdbc:h2:file:./db/cards.h2 with AUTO_SERVER=TRUE. Every JVM that opens it starts an H2 TCP server on all network interfaces (measured 2026-10-31 with bridge_v14: lsof shows *:<port>). A caller needs the key in db/cards.h2.lock.db and the default user has no password, so the exposure is for everyone who can read the database directory. Mitigation without an engine change: -Dh2.bindAddress=127.0.0.1 in the JVM call (a change of the qualified launch plan, so a requalification item).
